<div class="para">
<p>As of 2024, the population of Algeria is projected at 46.81 million, compared to 46.16 million in 2023.
It is the <a href="../african-countries-by-population.php">tenth-most populous country</a> in Africa and  
ranks <a href="../countries-by-population.php">33rd in the world</a>.
The population growth rate in 2024 is projected at 1.35 percent, the
<a href="../countries-by-population-growth-rate.php">81st highest</a> among 237 countries and dependent territories.</p>
<p>There are 23.87 million males and 22.94 million females in Algeria. The percentage of the male population
is 51%, compared to 49% of the female population. Algeria has 934k more
<a href="../countries-by-male-female-population.php">males than females</a>.
The <a href="../countries-by-sex-ratio.php">sex ratio</a> in Algeria in 2024 will be 104.074 males per 100 females.
Algeria is in the 209th position in terms of the female-to-male ratio.</p>
